newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daishowa Paper 6-mth current profit to jump - paper.
newsitem.headline: Daishowa Paper 6-mth current profit to jump - paper.

text.p: Daishowa Paper Manufacturing Co Ltd is expected to have posted parent current profit of around 10 billion yen in the half year to September, 2.5 times that of a year ago, a Japanese newspaper said on Thursday.

The business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said the estimated profit rise was due to drops in material costs on the back of lower pulp prices worldwide. For the full business year to March 1997, the newspaper forecast a moderate six percent year-on-year profit increase, which it said reflected a likely decline in paper prices in the latter half of the year.
A company spokesman declined to comment on the report.
